Revert "Merge fix/overlapping-patterns, which draws a pattern once for overlapping areas of a symbol, into basewithfixes"

This reverts commit ef5cd9cd2, reversing changes made to 0ad457403.

The new dev merges feature/palette-stack into basewithfixes. There pass 2 draws the pattern of overlapping areas of a
palette cutter once in the union of the areas (ticket 028), and the changes of the fix to Map.cs, SymDef.cs and
Symbol.cs conflict with it. The other merges of basewithfixes do not touch the files of the fix (@Pauli, Nov 25).
